name: Abdelaziz Mahdy
summary: Software developer at Paytic, working across the stack on a card and payment operations platform.
Maintainer of [executorch_flutter](https://github.com/abdelaziz-mahdy/executorch_flutter), the successor to pytorch_lite, and contributor to flutter, dio and media-kit.
Published deep-learning research on automated dental diagnosis at MIUA 2022 and ICCES 2021.

responsibilities: Full-stack feature development on a card and payment operations platform, across client-facing interfaces and server-side services.
Work spans onboarding, reconciliation and reporting areas of the product.

experience.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Developed and deployed two mobile apps using Flutter and Django, one published on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.intixel.hayaty).

Built CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment time by 30%, automating development, staging and demo environments.

extra: Employee of the Year 2023, for contributions to app development, backend optimization and blockchain integration.
